tut.ban: First, a ban. Banning a hero stops the other team using it. Tap any hero, then Ban, or tap Ban on the Coach bar.
tut.pick: Now pick a hero for your team. Heroes with an up arrow are strong this patch. Tap a hero, or tap Pick.
help.draft.see: The phase on top: Ban phase with the no-entry sign, or Pick phase. Bans fill the row under the lanes.
help.draft.do: Ban heroes their players know best. Pick heroes your players know and that fit the role.
help.draft.know: Teams ban 3 heroes each, or 5 in league and playoff games. If time runs out the Coach chooses.
